import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Create figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Customer Segmentation Analysis: Demographics, Spending & Behavior', 
             fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Calculate age and total spending
df['Age'] = 2024 - df['Year_Birth']
df['TotalSpending'] = (df['MntWines'] + df['MntFruits'] + df['MntMeatProducts'] + 
                       df['MntFishProducts'] + df['MntSweetProducts'] + df['MntGoldProds'])

# 1. Income vs Total Spending by Education
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
education_colors = {'PhD': '#e74c3c', 'Master': '#3498db', 'Graduation': '#2ecc71', 
                   '2n Cycle': '#f39c12', 'Basic': '#9b59b6'}
for education in df['Education'].unique():
    mask = df['Education'] == education
    ax1.scatter(df[mask]['Income'], df[mask]['TotalSpending'], 
               label=education, alpha=0.6, s=50, color=education_colors.get(education, '#95a5a6'))
ax1.set_xlabel('Income ($)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Spending ($)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Income vs Total Spending by Education Level', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Education', loc='upper left')
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age Distribution by Marital Status
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
marital_order = df['Marital_Status'].value_counts().head(5).index.tolist()
df_filtered = df[df['Marital_Status'].isin(marital_order)]
sns.violinplot(data=df_filtered, x='Marital_Status', y='Age', ax=ax2, palette='Set2')
ax2.set_xlabel('Marital Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Age (years)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Marital Status', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=15)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 3. Product Category Spending Breakdown
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
product_spending = {
    'Wines': df['MntWines'].sum(),
    'Meat': df['MntMeatProducts'].sum(),
    'Fish': df['MntFishProducts'].sum(),
    'Fruits': df['MntFruits'].sum(),
    'Sweets': df['MntSweetProducts'].sum(),
    'Gold': df['MntGoldProds'].sum()
}
colors_pie = ['#8b0000', '#d62728', '#17becf', '#2ca02c', '#ff7f0e', '#ffd700']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(product_spending.values(), labels=product_spending.keys(),
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors_pie,
                                     textprops={'fontsize': 11, 'fontweight': 'bold'})
ax3.set_title('Total Spending Distribution by Product Category', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Purchase Channel Comparison
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
channel_data = {
    'Web': df['NumWebPurchases'].sum(),
    'Catalog': df['NumCatalogPurchases'].sum(),
    'Store': df['NumStorePurchases'].sum(),
    'Deals': df['NumDealsPurchases'].sum()
}
bars = ax4.bar(channel_data.keys(), channel_data.values(), 
               color=['#3498db', '#e74c3c', '#2ecc71', '#f39c12'], 
               edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax4.set_xlabel('Purchase Channel', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Number of Purchases', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Purchase Channel Performance', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# Add value labels on bars
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax4.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
            f'{int(height):,}',
            ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
